data.segment_definition: Per feature: segment 0 is the modal value; segments 1-3 are user-weighted terciles of all other values. Segments are defined from pre-treatment feature values only, never from outcomes.
data.adjusted_definition: Adjusted segment effect = mean cross-fitted doubly-robust score among the segment's users (corrects for imbalance on all 12 features); interval = mean ± 1.96 standard errors.

visit.adjustment: Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) and Holm (FWER) across all segment tests for this outcome

conversion.adjustment: Benjamini-Hochberg (FDR) and Holm (FWER) across all segment tests for this outcome
